_doc: Present-mode chapters (spec 10.3). Inlined by build.py as ATLAS_CONFIG.story. Titles: *phrase* renders in lime italic. Stats and {tokens} in body are computed at runtime from data by core/js/investor/present.js (see STAT there); nothing numeric is typed here. filters = {set: [visible values]} applied on top of an all-visible baseline; camera = {fit:view} or {center,zoom,pitch?,bearing?}; ppa = PPA section to scroll to.

chapters.title: The market: *{tam.n}* fuelled generators
chapters.body: Every subsidised biogas, biomass, EfW, landfill and sewage-gas generator in Great Britain. Indicative TCV potential is {tam.pot}; {tam.big} of it comes from {tam.bigN} sites ≥ 10 MW, where AD-peaker economics are stretched furthest.

chapters.title: The verified *pipeline*
chapters.body: {sam.n} AD peakers matched to the Balancing Mechanism, sized by Year-5 contract value. Hollow rings are the {sam.unpriced} sites still awaiting a BM figure.

chapters.title: Where flexibility *pays most*
chapters.body: Tier 1 and Tier 2 connections cluster around London, Kent and East Anglia, where the grid runs tightest and offers are called most often.

chapters.title: Stranded hydro in *the Highlands*
chapters.body: Run-of-river schemes generating more than the network will take. The stranded share runs Bitcoin mining around the clock, so its value is the BTC it mines.

chapters.title: Why now: *the crossover*
chapters.body: The guaranteed FiT export rate rises with CPI while the forward curve falls away. At 3% CPI it overtakes the Cal-2028 forward.

chapters.title: Who *buys the power*
chapters.body: The largest external REGO certificate holder for each site: strong evidence of the offtaker, not contractual proof.
